<!--
Supplement B: the atlas results as filterable tables, one per manuscript
simulation plus the diagnostic atlas. It reads the precomputed summaries in
data/ and uses the rates of the manuscript (forced choice: fits passing the
minimal lme4 checks; other families: every finite p-value). The earlier full
report with text and figures is archived in archive/. Render with

    quarto render simulation-atlas/Supplement-B-Simulation-atlas-explorer.qmd
-->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(htmltools)
library(reactable)

core <- read.csv(here("simulation-atlas/data/atlas-summary.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
diagnostic <- read.csv(here("simulation-atlas/data/diagnostic-atlas-summary.csv"), check.names = FALSE)

pct <- function(x) ifelse(is.finite(x), sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x), "--")
par_text <- function(x) ifelse(is.finite(x), as.character(round(x, 4)), "--")

# Sensitivity sweeps, in the order the rows are listed
varied_label <- c(
  main_effect_surface = "Main effects",
  sample_size = "Sample size",
  scale_location = "Intercept",
  latent_location = "Intercept",
  trial_count = "Trials",
  chance_level = "Chance level",
  icc = "ICC",
  item_count = "Number of items",
  latent_dispersion = "Latent SD"
)
varied_order <- unname(unique(varied_label))

# One row per generating scenario, one rate column per fitted model (plus
# "<column>_flag", the share of that model's fits failing the fit-quality checks)
wide <- function(family, models, sort_by) {
  dat <- core[core$family == family, ]
  out <- dat[!duplicated(dat$scenario_id), ]
  for (m in names(models)) {
    d <- dat[dat$model_label == m, ]
    out[[models[[m]]]] <- d$rejection_rate_ok[match(out$scenario_id, d$scenario_id)]
    out[[paste0(models[[m]], "_flag")]] <- d$fit_problem_rate[match(out$scenario_id, d$scenario_id)]
  }
  # rows ordered by sweep (the first one, for a scenario shared by several), then by the parameter values
  first <- vapply(strsplit(out$slice_membership, ";", fixed = TRUE), function(z) {
    v <- unname(varied_label[z])
    v[!is.na(v)][1]
  }, "")
  out$varied_main <- factor(first, levels = varied_order)
  out[do.call(order, c(list(out$varied_main), unname(as.list(out[sort_by])))), ]
}

# Rates above alpha = .05 are shaded red, more intensely as they approach 1
rate_style <- function(value) {
  if (!is.finite(value) || value <= .05) return(NULL)
  a <- .75 * min(1, (value - .05) / .95)
  list(background = sprintf("rgba(192, 57, 43, %.3f)", a), color = if (a > .45) "#fff")
}

# Drop-down filter with exact matching (numbers compared with a tolerance)
exact_js <- JS("function(rows, id, value) {
  return rows.filter(function(row) {
    var v = row.values[id];
    if (typeof v === 'number') return Math.abs(v - Number(value)) < 1e-9;
    return String(v) === value;
  });
}")
select_filter <- function(table_id, choices = NULL) {
  function(values, name) {
    v <- if (!is.null(choices)) choices else if (is.numeric(values)) sort(unique(values[is.finite(values)])) else
      unique(as.character(values[!is.na(values) & values != ""]))
    lab <- if (is.numeric(v)) par_text(v) else v
    tags$select(
      onchange = sprintf("Reactable.setFilter('%s', '%s', event.target.value || undefined)", table_id, name),
      `aria-label` = paste("Filter", name),
      tags$option(value = "", "All"),
      lapply(seq_along(v), function(i) tags$option(value = as.character(v[i]), lab[i]))
    )
  }
}
col_par <- function(name, table_id, width = 80) {
  colDef(name = name, minWidth = width, align = "right", cell = function(value) par_text(value),
         filterMethod = exact_js, filterInput = select_filter(table_id))
}
col_chr <- function(name, table_id, width = 110) {
  colDef(name = name, minWidth = width, filterMethod = exact_js, filterInput = select_filter(table_id))
}
# flag: optional share of flagged (excluded) fits, shown in brackets under the rate
col_rate <- function(name, width = 88, shade = TRUE, flag = NULL) {
  colDef(name = name, minWidth = width, align = "right", filterable = FALSE, style = if (shade) rate_style,
         cell = function(value, index) {
           if (is.null(flag)) return(pct(value))
           tagList(pct(value), tags$div(class = "flag-note", sprintf("(%s flagged)", pct(flag[index]))))
         })
}

atlas_table <- function(out, table_id, columns, groups) {
  out <- out[names(columns)]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  reactable(
    out, elementId = table_id, columns = columns, columnGroups = groups,
    filterable = TRUE, sortable = TRUE, pagination = FALSE,
    striped = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, compact = TRUE, wrap = TRUE,
    defaultColDef = colDef(headerVAlign = "bottom")
  )
}
```

Each table repeats a simulation of the manuscript over a declared set of sensitivity scenarios, varying one parameter at a time (or two main effects jointly). Generating interactions are always zero, so a rejection under the matched model estimates the nominal rate and under any other model a pseudo-interaction rate. Each scenario has 3,000 Monte Carlo replications; rates use α = .05 and the replications with a valid test, as stated above each table. The drop-down filters select parameter values; fixing all parameters but one lists a sensitivity sweep. The scenario grid, simulation code and summaries are in the `simulation-atlas/` folder of the project repository.

## Simulation 1: Forced-choice accuracy

[Product-term rejection rate at α = .05 among fits passing the minimal fit-quality checks; in brackets under each rate, the share of that model's fits flagged by the checks and therefore excluded. The age-by-group term is zero on the chance-corrected logit scale; the chance-corrected model is the matched model. Coefficients on the generating scale; random-intercept ICC .30.]{.tab-note}

```{r}
#| label: tab-forced-choice

id <- "atlas-forced-choice"
fc <- wide("forced_choice", c(
  "Chance-corrected binomial logit" = "cc",
  "Standard binomial logit" = "logit",
  "Standard binomial probit" = "probit",
  "Gaussian identity" = "gauss"
), sort_by = c("N", "k_trials", "chance", "beta_intercept", "beta_age", "beta_group"))

atlas_table(fc, id,
  columns = list(
    N = col_par("N", id),
    k_trials = col_par("Trials", id),
    chance = col_par("Chance level", id),
    beta_intercept = col_par("Intercept", id),
    beta_age = col_par("Age coef.", id),
    beta_group = col_par("Group coef.", id),
    cc = col_rate("Chance-corrected logit (matched)", 100, flag = fc$cc_flag),
    logit = col_rate("Standard logit", 100, flag = fc$logit_flag),
    probit = col_rate("Standard probit", 100, flag = fc$probit_flag),
    gauss = col_rate("Gaussian identity", 100, flag = fc$gauss_flag)
  ),
  groups = list(
    colGroup("Generating scenario", c("N", "k_trials", "chance", "beta_intercept", "beta_age", "beta_group")),
    colGroup("Rejection rate by fitted GLMM / LMM (in brackets: fits flagged and excluded)", c("cc", "logit", "probit", "gauss"))
  )
)
```

## Simulation 2: Logit versus probit

[Product-term rejection rate at α = .05 of random-intercept GLMMs fitted with the generating link (matched) and with the other link. The condition-by-group term is zero on the generating link scale. Coefficients on the generating link scale (logit coefficients are 1.65 times the probit ones).]{.tab-note}

```{r}
#| label: tab-within-family

id <- "atlas-within-family"
wf <- wide("within_family", c("Binomial logit" = "fit_logit", "Binomial probit" = "fit_probit"),
           sort_by = c("n_subjects", "k_trials", "target_icc", "beta_intercept", "beta_group", "beta_condition"))
logit_gen <- wf$generating_link == "logit"
wf$matched <- ifelse(logit_gen, wf$fit_logit, wf$fit_probit)
wf$wrong <- ifelse(logit_gen, wf$fit_probit, wf$fit_logit)
wf <- wf[order(wf$generating_link != "probit"), ]

atlas_table(wf, id,
  columns = list(
    generating_link = col_chr("Generating link", id, 90),
    n_subjects = col_par("Participants", id, 95),
    k_trials = col_par("Trials per cell", id),
    target_icc = col_par("ICC", id),
    beta_intercept = col_par("Intercept", id),
    beta_group = col_par("Group coef.", id),
    beta_condition = col_par("Condition coef.", id),
    matched = col_rate("Matched link"),
    wrong = col_rate("Wrong link")
  ),
  groups = list(
    colGroup("Generating scenario", c("generating_link", "n_subjects", "k_trials", "target_icc", "beta_intercept", "beta_group", "beta_condition")),
    colGroup("Rejection rate by fitted link", c("matched", "wrong"))
  )
)
```

## Simulation 3: Sum scores

[Product-term rejection rate at α = .05. The x-by-group term is zero on the latent generating scale. Items scored 0 to 3; the item-threshold shift moves expected totals toward the lower (positive shift) or upper (negative shift) part of the score range. Coefficients on the latent scale.]{.tab-note}

```{r}
#| label: tab-sum-scores

id <- "atlas-sum-scores"
ss <- wide("sum_scores", c(
  "Latent generating scale" = "latent",
  "Observed sum-score identity" = "identity",
  "Gaussian-probit bounded score" = "bounded"
), sort_by = c("N", "J", "theta_sd", "threshold_shift", "beta_x", "beta_group"))

atlas_table(ss, id,
  columns = list(
    N = col_par("N", id),
    J = col_par("Items", id),
    theta_sd = col_par("Latent SD", id),
    threshold_shift = col_par("Threshold shift", id),
    beta_x = col_par("Predictor coef.", id),
    beta_group = col_par("Group coef.", id),
    latent = col_rate("Latent scale (matched)"),
    identity = col_rate("Sum-score identity"),
    bounded = col_rate("Bounded-score probit")
  ),
  groups = list(
    colGroup("Generating scenario", c("N", "J", "theta_sd", "threshold_shift", "beta_x", "beta_group")),
    colGroup("Rejection rate by fitted model", c("latent", "identity", "bounded"))
  )
)
```

## Diagnostics

[Count: Poisson log-generated data fitted with an identity (wrong) versus a log (correct) link. Chance-floor accuracy: standard logit (wrong) versus chance-corrected logit (correct) GLMMs, with the generating model of Simulation 1. Binary repeated trials: probit-generated data fitted with a logit (wrong) versus a probit (correct) GLMM, in the 2 x 2 design and with a continuous predictor x ~ Uniform(0, 1). Gamma: log-generated data fitted with an inverse (wrong) versus a log (correct) link. *N*: participants. *Main effects*: multiplier of the two main effects (count and Gamma only), the severity setting where the intercept only rescales the means. Flagging rates are given as correct / wrong link; DHARMa: range across the residual checks applicable to the design, package defaults; Pregibon: N.I. = not identifiable in the saturated 2 x 2 design. *AIC prefers correct*: share of replications in which the correct-link model had the lower AIC. *Wrong-link fits*: share of replications in which the wrong-link model returned a finite product-term test; the other rates are conditional on these fits (non-converged GLMs count as failed, as in the manuscript).]{.tab-note}

```{r}
#| label: tab-diagnostics

id <- "atlas-diagnostics"
# cases in the order of the manuscript diagnostic table
case_label <- c(count = "Count", forced_choice = "Chance-floor accuracy", within_family = "Binary repeated trials, 2 x 2",
                binary_continuous = "Binary repeated trials, continuous x", gamma = "Gamma")
dg <- diagnostic[diagnostic$family %in% names(case_label), ]
dg$used <- dg$applicable %in% TRUE & dg$computed %in% TRUE

range_text <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return("--")
  if (length(x) == 1 || diff(range(x)) == 0) return(pct(x[1]))
  paste0(pct(min(x)), "–", pct(max(x)))
}
pair_text <- function(correct, wrong) {
  if (correct == "--" && wrong == "--") return("--")
  paste(correct, "/", wrong)
}

out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(dg, dg$scenario_id), function(d) {
  dh <- d[grepl("^DHARMa", d$diagnostic) & d$used, ]
  pg <- d[grepl("^Pregibon", d$diagnostic), ]
  ai <- d[d$diagnostic == "AIC favors generating link" & d$used, ]
  # severity is the intercept, or the main-effect multiplier for count and Gamma
  severity <- if (d$family[1] %in% c("count", "gamma")) "Main effects" else "Intercept"
  data.frame(
    case = unname(case_label[d$family[1]]),
    varied_main = if (grepl("sample_size", d$diagnostic_slice_membership[1])) "Sample size" else severity,
    n = if (d$family[1] %in% c("within_family", "binary_continuous")) d$n_subjects[1] else d$N[1],
    intercept = d$beta_intercept[1],
    multiplier = if (d$family[1] %in% c("count", "gamma")) d$beta_main_1_multiplier[1] else NA_real_,
    fits = d$pseudo_interaction_n_successful[1] / d$n_attempted[1],
    pseudo = d$pseudo_interaction_detection_rate[1],
    dharma = pair_text(range_text(dh$correct_link_flag_rate), range_text(dh$detection_rate)),
    pregibon = if (!nrow(pg) || !(pg$applicable[1] %in% TRUE)) "N.I." else if (!pg$used[1]) "--" else
      pair_text(pct(pg$correct_link_flag_rate[1]), pct(pg$detection_rate[1])),
    aic = if (nrow(ai)) ai$detection_rate[1] else NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
out$varied_main <- factor(out$varied_main, levels = c("Sample size", "Intercept", "Main effects"))
out <- out[order(match(out$case, case_label), out$varied_main, out$n, out$intercept, out$multiplier), ]

atlas_table(out, id,
  columns = list(
    case = col_chr("Case", id, 150),
    n = col_par("N", id),
    intercept = col_par("Intercept", id),
    multiplier = col_par("Main effects", id),
    fits = col_rate("Wrong-link fits", 80, shade = FALSE),
    pseudo = col_rate("Pseudo-interaction rate, wrong link", 120),
    dharma = colDef(name = "DHARMa flagging, correct / wrong link", minWidth = 195, align = "right", filterable = FALSE),
    pregibon = colDef(name = "Pregibon flagging, correct / wrong link", minWidth = 130, align = "right", filterable = FALSE),
    aic = col_rate("AIC prefers correct link", 100, shade = FALSE)
  ),
  groups = list(
    colGroup("Scenario", c("case", "n", "intercept", "multiplier")),
    colGroup("Rates across replications", c("fits", "pseudo", "dharma", "pregibon", "aic"))
  )
)
```
